events.title: AI Tinkerers Berlin — August Meetup
events.desc: Hands-on demo night for practitioners building with foundation models — 8-minute talks/demos, agents, RAG, MLOps. Application-based RSVP.

events.title: Vector Space Meetup (Qdrant)
events.desc: Qdrant-hosted retrieval meetup — recent edition paneled n8n, Cognee, deepset, and LlamaIndex on retrieval in the age of agents.
events.warn: Recurring series; next edition inferred from cadence — watch luma.com/vsm-berlin for the locked date.

events.title: AI Agents Berlin — H2 monthly meetup
events.desc: Monthly IRL meetups plus online sessions across two tracks (Personalized AI, DeFAI), building toward the Agentic Economy Forum.
events.warn: H2 2026 season announced; individual meetup dates are published on their Luma close to each event.

events.title: buildersklub Berlin — September Meetup
events.desc: Monthly meetup for decision-makers and hands-on builders on AI and automation in real workflows — real stories, no pitches.

events.title: Berlin Analytics & AI Hackathon
events.desc: Modern-data-stack hackathon organized by Snowflake, Lightdash, Collate, and JustWatch — capped at 50 participants.
events.warn: Announced on Luma without a locked date at research time — verify before planning.

events.title: {Tech: Europe} AI Hackathon — Berlin Edition
events.desc: Full-weekend hackathon with sponsor credits from OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Weaviate, Runpod, Dust and others. ~90 participants, finalist pitches Sunday.
events.warn: Organizer announced an Oct 11–12 edition — confirm the date and registration on their Luma before planning.

events.title: AI, Machine Learning & Data Science Conference
events.desc: Three-day research-and-practice conference — ~30 sessions on robotics, MLOps, trustworthy AI, HPC, and multimodal understanding.

events.title: The Berlin AI Conference 2026
events.desc: Evening conference gathering 150 Berlin business, product, and tech leaders — panel plus networking; follows sold-out 2024/2025 editions.

events.title: NVIDIA GTC Berlin
events.desc: NVIDIA's European GTC — Jensen Huang keynote Oct 21, then sessions and hands-on labs across the full AI stack: infra, open models, agentic and physical AI.

events.title: Agentic Economy Forum
events.desc: AI Agents Berlin's standalone forum anchoring their H2 season — agentic AI meets web3 across Personalized AI and DeFAI tracks. Their AI Agents Summit drew 400+ in person.
events.warn: Announced for H2 2026, exact date and venue not yet published — check their site.

events.title: Berlin Robotics × AI Hackathon
events.desc: Weekend hackathon at the intersection of robotics and agentic coding — application-gated (Luma RSVP alone doesn't secure a spot).
events.warn: First edition announced; date not locked at research time — verify on Luma.

events.title: MLcon Berlin 2026
events.desc: Week-long generative-AI and ML engineering conference — workshops, keynotes, and an expo; also attendable online.
